name: curator
description: Maintenance layer for the user's typed auto-memory store. At every SessionStart, runs four cheap heuristic checks (date_decayed, path_broken, broken_index, orphaned_memory) against the memories at ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/projects/<encoded>/memory/ inside a wall-clock budget, and records what it finds. The one-line SessionStart pointer to those findings stays off until /curator review ships. Never edits the memory store directly. Builds on the Onlooker ecosystem plugin.
